overview: Enterprise AI tools accelerate internal workflows, cutting days to minutes.
Generative AI platforms expand into video creation and agentic assistance.
AI firms pledge resources for cybersecurity and scientific research.

top.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
top.summary: Oracle uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to let non‑specialists perform tasks like talent market analysis and SQL queries in minutes, improving speed and consistency across recruiting, engineering, and operations.

top.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
top.summary: Pollo AI leverages GPT‑5.6, GPT‑6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5 to let creators generate videos and ads from simple prompts, reducing model‑selection time and speeding production for millions of users.

top.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
top.summary: Anthropic launches the Cyber Mission, offering frontier Claude models, engineering support, and funding to help secure critical infrastructure and open‑source software against emerging threats.

top.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
top.summary: Anthropic commits $150 million to the U.S. Genesis Mission, providing Claude AI to federal labs and agencies to accelerate scientific discovery and expand AI‑for‑Science tools.

top.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
top.summary: Ben Affleck’s viral interview showcases his self‑taught knowledge of AI concepts and his involvement in an AI filmmaking startup sold to Netflix, highlighting celebrity engagement with AI.

top.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
top.summary: Google introduces an agentic Gemini AI for businesses, capable of planning, executing tasks, and integrating with enterprise tools, with a model picker that includes third‑party options.
